message: Astra: Within Ya na’s scene, what private understanding does “Inner Monologue:” add beyond the fear already expressed aloud? Which sentence would you examine most closely to judge that difference? What have you found, and what remains uncertain? Why would further thought be worth its time rather than an informative writing attempt now; what unresolved choice could instead make writing premature? What evidence would settle that allocation? Could you choose your next step, briefly explain its purpose in English, and carry it out?
speaker: Astra
